description: This file defines the LeaveAssignmentService class, which manages leave assignment operations within the OrangeHRM system. It includes methods for assigning leave, validating date ranges, handling leave request creation, and interacting with workflow and entitlements. The class utilizes multiple traits and interacts with other services to facilitate leave management workflows.

classes.name: LeaveAssignmentService
classes.description: A service class responsible for assigning leave requests, validating leave periods, and managing leave workflows within the HR system.

methods.name: assignLeave
methods.description: Main method to assign leave, validating date range, overlap, and work shift constraints, then saving the leave request.

methods.name: saveLeaveRequest
methods.description: Handles the creation and persistence of leave requests, including entitlement checks, holiday considerations, comments, and dispatching related events.

methods.name: getLeaveRequestStatus
methods.description: Determines the status of a leave request based on date attributes such as weekends and holidays, or defaults to an approved status by workflow.

methods.name: allowToExceedLeaveBalance
methods.description: Indicates whether the employee can exceed their leave balance; overridden to return true in this class.

methods.name: getWorkflowItemForAssignAction
methods.description: Retrieves the workflow state machine item corresponding to the 'ASSIGN' action, with caching.
